top_news.title: "Congress sides with those who exploit women": Bansuri Swaraj seeks action against Akoijam in JNU harassment case
top_news.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Bansuri Swaraj on Thursday accused Congress leadership of remaining silent over sexual harassment allegations against Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam, saying her party's delegation had approached Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla seeking action in the matter. The BJP women MPs' delegation met the Lok Sabha Speaker and submitted a memorandum seeking action against Akoijam, a Congress MP from Inner Manipur, following allegations of sexual harassment involving 11 female students at Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU). Addressing a press conference after the meeting, Bansuri Swaraj said, It is highly unfortunate that the Congress party consistently sides with those who exploit women. When Bimal Akoijam--a sitting MP from the Congress party--sexually harassed 11 female students, JNU's internal committee found that the complaints filed by these students against him were truthful and substantiated by facts. She further said that Akoijam was dismissed from his position at JNU on October 9, 2026, following the internal committee's findings, and questioned the silence of senior Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge and Sonia Gandhi. Yet, there is an absolutely deafening silence from Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Kharge ji, and Sonia Gandhi, Swaraj said. Today, under the guidance and leadership of our Mahila Morcha National President and fellow MP, Rupkumari Choudhary, we met with the Speaker of the Lok Sabha, Om Birla. We appealed to the President, Droupadi Murmu. Yesterday, a delegation met with the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women (NCW), Vijaya Rahatkar, and today, we submitted a memorandum to Om Birla. We had a very productive discussion, she added. BJP Mahila Morcha National President and MP Roop Kumari Chaudhary described the incident as shameful and said the party would continue to raise the issue until the students received justice and protection. Chaudhary said the party was concerned about the safety of the complainants, who continue to study at the university, and called on the Congress to suspend or expel Akoijam. The incident that took place at JNU was truly shameful. JNU Professor Dr. Bimol Akoijam-who is also a Congress MP from Manipur-subjected 11 young women to mistreatment, sexual harassment, and abuse. Why haven't Congress leaders like Rahul Gandhi or Priyanka Gandhi come forward to stand up for these young women? Rahul Gandhi has not uttered a single word in support of these daughters. Instead, he has provided protection to Bimol Akoijam, she said. The Bharatiya Janata Party's Mahila Morcha has taken to the streets in protest-to ensure that these daughters receive justice, their dignity is upheld, and they are provided with the protection they deserve. top_news.title: Musk faces intense criticism after reports of Starlink restricted in Ukraine amid strikes from Russia
top_news.summary: Billionaire tech mogul Elon Musk in facing intense scruitiny as his satellite communication network, SpaceX, finds itself at the center of an escalating international backlash, following reports of restrictions on satellite communications services in Ukraine amid continued Russian strikes, triggering criticism from US lawmakers and renewed questions over the power of private technology companies to influence the course of a war. As Ukraine grapples with the reported disruption of Starlink and Starshield connectivity, Musk has defended the distinction between the two systems, arguing that Starshield is controlled by the US government and that Starlink, a commercial service operated by SpaceX, cannot be used for offensive military action. The controversy has placed Musk at the centre of a politically sensitive debate over military communications, civilian safety and the extent to which a private company can determine access to critical technology during an armed conflict. The backlash intensified after the Democrats on the House Foreign Affairs Committee criticised the reported restrictions, linking them to Russian attacks and questioning the circumstances surrounding the disruption. Restricting Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield access while ballistic missiles and drones attack Ukraine is unconscionable. The admin also reportedly gave Kyiv no warning of the strikes. Trump's making a choice-and it directly aids Putin's slaughter of Ukrainian civilians, the Democrats House Foreign Affairs Committee said in a post on X. Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal also raised concerns about the reported disruption, warning that the episode could establish a dangerous precedent for the use of private technology in foreign conflicts. First, Trump said that Ukraine should get a new President. Then, Starlink, run by Elon Musk, was severely restricted in Ukraine -- meaning a majority of battlefield communications were totally stopped -- a move Ukraine is saying the US ordered. This sets a dangerous precedent of interference in foreign wars, and of the ability of a single corporation to shut off communications at will. We need answers, Jayapal said in a post on X. The criticism came as Ukrainian authorities sought to restore connectivity and assess the operational consequences of the reported restrictions. Mykhailo Fedorov, former Minister of Defence of Ukraine, said in a post on X that Starlink connectivity was being restored, while calling for the removal of restrictions affecting Starshield. Starlink connectivity at speeds of up to 160 km/h is being restored. Removing Starshield's speed limit entirely is now critical for Ukraine's defense. Thank you, Elon Musk. We hope for your continued support, Fedorov said. Musk responded by distinguishing between the two satellite systems and placing responsibility for Starshield restrictions on the US government. Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS. Starlink is a commercial service owned and controlled by SpaceX. Usage of Starlink is limited to civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company, he said. The explanation, however, has done little to quiet the debate over the reported disruption and the reliance of Ukrainian forces on satellite communications. According to Axios, Ukraine's military operations have been affected by restrictions on satellite communications services, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy raising concerns over disruptions to Starlink connectivity as Kyiv faces continued Russian strikes. Zelenskyy accused Musk of restricting Ukrainian access to Starlink during an interview with British broadcaster Piers Morgan on Piers Morgan Uncensored, alleging that the disruption had affected military operations and Ukraine's ability to defend against Russian strikes. I am sure they knew what they did, absolutely, Zelenskyy said, referring to the reported disruption. Because it was 1 am at night, (when) Starlink was blocked by SpaceX and the United States, he added Emphasising the system's role in protecting civilians, Zelenskyy said, It's not just about attack. It's also about defending life. He further said that the disruption had affected the ability to intercept incoming attacks. People were killed because, not enough destroying, not enough interceptors, including interceptors with Starlink, which didn't work. Of course, he added. Asked whether he was angry with Musk, Zelenskyy said, Yes, I think he is not right. It's a big mistake. I don't know him, or somebody pushed him to, I don't know really, he added. Warning of the possible consequences, Zelenskyy said, It's a big mistake.This decision will bring a lot of human losses. Of course, people will die. Of course, if attacks continue and if Starlink will not work, it's not helpful. According to CNN, Ukrainian authorities said they were caught off guard by restrictions affecting Starshield, the military-grade satellite communications system owned and controlled by the US government. CNN, citing two US officials, reported that the decision to limit Ukrainian access to Starshield was not a high-level US policy decision. Ukrainian forces rely on Starlink to operate reconnaissance and interceptor drones, gather intelligence and conduct other military operations. A Ukrainian military source with direct knowledge of the operational impact told CNN, The complications are substantial. We're investigating connection issues in detail. What will be affected is the front line and occupied territories, the source said, adding, We were getting ready for this. A Ukrainian defence ministry source also told CNN, This situation significantly complicates logistics, unmanned systems, forces operations, mid-range strikes, etc. The controversy has also brought renewed attention to India's cautious approach towards licensing Starlink, with security concerns at the centre of the regulatory debate. The Ministry of Communications had earlier rejected claims that India's licensing framework was discriminatory after Musk alleged that certain vested interests were blocking Starlink's plans in the country. The ministry's statement followed Musk's post on X claiming that Starlink's India plans were being blocked by certain oligarchs. In response, the Ministry of Communications stated that India had established a fair and non-discriminatory authorisation framework for telecommunications services, including satellite communications. It noted that telecom licences had been granted to three global mobile personal communication by satellite services using non-geosynchronous satellite orbit-based communications, while stressing that security compliance remained a prerequisite for moving forward. As criticism mounts over the reported restrictions in Ukraine, the episode has placed Musk in the middle of a debate that extends beyond his company's commercial ambitions

articles.title: "Congress sides with those who exploit women": Bansuri Swaraj seeks action against Akoijam in JNU harassment case
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Bansuri Swaraj on Thursday accused Congress leadership of remaining silent over sexual harassment allegations against Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam, saying her party's delegation had approached Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla seeking action in the matter. The BJP women MPs' delegation met the Lok Sabha Speaker and submitted a memorandum seeking action against Akoijam, a Congress MP from Inner Manipur, following allegations of sexual harassment involving 11 female students at Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU). Addressing a press conference after the meeting, Bansuri Swaraj said, It is highly unfortunate that the Congress party consistently sides with those who exploit women. When Bimal Akoijam--a sitting MP from the Congress party--sexually harassed 11 female students, JNU's internal committee found that the complaints filed by these students against him were truthful and substantiated by facts. She further said that Akoijam was dismissed from his position at JNU on October 9, 2026, following the internal committee's findings, and questioned the silence of senior Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge and Sonia Gandhi. Yet, there is an absolutely deafening silence from Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Kharge ji, and Sonia Gandhi, Swaraj said. Today, under the guidance and leadership of our Mahila Morcha National President and fellow MP, Rupkumari Choudhary, we met with the Speaker of the Lok Sabha, Om Birla. We appealed to the President, Droupadi Murmu. Yesterday, a delegation met with the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women (NCW), Vijaya Rahatkar, and today, we submitted a memorandum to Om Birla. We had a very productive discussion, she added. BJP Mahila Morcha National President and MP Roop Kumari Chaudhary described the incident as shameful and said the party would continue to raise the issue until the students received justice and protection. Chaudhary said the party was concerned about the safety of the complainants, who continue to study at the university, and called on the Congress to suspend or expel Akoijam. The incident that took place at JNU was truly shameful. JNU Professor Dr. Bimol Akoijam-who is also a Congress MP from Manipur-subjected 11 young women to mistreatment, sexual harassment, and abuse. Why haven't Congress leaders like Rahul Gandhi or Priyanka Gandhi come forward to stand up for these young women? Rahul Gandhi has not uttered a single word in support of these daughters. Instead, he has provided protection to Bimol Akoijam, she said. The Bharatiya Janata Party's Mahila Morcha has taken to the streets in protest-to ensure that these daughters receive justice, their dignity is upheld, and they are provided with the protection they deserve. On the 12th October, we held a protest in Delhi. We also organized protests across the entire state on the 10th October, demanding that the Congress party take action against him. On 13th October, a delegation met with the President of India to ensure the protection of these young girls. On 14th October, we met with the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women, and today, a delegation of Members of Parliament met with the Speaker of the Lok Sabha. We argued that an individual facing such allegations has no right to sit in the House, she added. BJP Mahila Morcha National Vice President Daggubati Purandeswari also criticised Congress leadership, alleging that the party had failed to take action against Akoijam despite the university's internal inquiry. Purandeswari said the university's Vice-Chancellor had constituted an internal committee after complaints emerged, and the committee found Akoijam guilty of molesting 11 female students. She also referred to an interview in which Akoijam had reportedly spoken about the number of complaints against him, saying she was surprised that he had spoken about the complaints in that manner. Purandeswari praised the students for coming forward with their complaints, saying it required courage to speak out against a professor while studying at the same institution. Questioning Congress leaders' public positions on women's rights, she said, On one hand we have Congress party leaders like Rahul Gandhi who says 'Smash the Patriarchy', and on the other hand we have Priyanka Gandhi ji who says 'Main ladki hoon, main lad sakti hoon' (I am a girl, I can fight). Today, we would like to question Priyanka Gandhi ji. She alleged that the Congress leadership's silence amounted to protecting Akoijam and called on the party to explain why it had not suspended or expelled him. Purandeswari also referred to allegations of misconduct against AAP MP Sanjay Singh during a recent protest involving BJP women workers, demanding an explanation from the opposition. A BJP women MPs' delegation, including Purandeswari, Swaraj and Chaudhary, met Speaker Birla and submitted a letter seeking action against Akoijam. The letter said the issue concerned respect for women, safety of girl students, moral accountability in public life and conduct of political parties. According to the letter, 11 female students had filed sexual harassment complaints against Akoijam, who was a professor at JNU before becoming a Congress MP from Manipur. The university's Internal Committee conducted an inquiry and found the allegations against him to be substantiated, following which the administration issued an order on October 9, 2026, dismissing him from service with immediate effect. The delegation also attached copies of the FIR and other documents. On Wednesday, Chaudhary said NCW chairperson Vijaya K Rahatkar assured the delegation she would look into the matter. We've been assured that she will definitely look into the matter given the situation, she said. Once the investigation found him guilty, he was fired, but under Congress's protection, Congress leaders haven't said a single word about him yet, she alleged. JNU dismissed Akoijam with immediate effect on October 9 after its Internal Committee recommended major punishment following an inquiry under the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act. Akoijam had earlier accused the administration of failing to provide him a copy of the inquiry report, needed to exercise his right to appeal, and alleged a violation of confidentiality under Section 16 of the POSH Act. Separately, Delhi Police registered an FIR on October 11 at Vasant Kunj North police station on a complaint by JNU's Chief Security Officer, under Sections 75, 75(1)(i), 75(1)(iv) and 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The matter is under investigation. Earlier, a delegation of BJP women leaders, including Lok Sabha MPs Kamaljeet Sehrawat, Bansuri Swaraj and Malvika Devi, Rajya Sabha MPs S. Phangnon Konyak and Geeta Shakya, and senior leader Rekha Sharma, met President Droupadi Murmu and submitted a memorandum seeking strict action. (ANI)

On 14th October, we met with the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women, and today, a delegation of Members of Parliament met with the Speaker of the Lok Sabha. We argued that an individual facing such allegations has no right to sit in the House, she added. BJP Mahila Morcha National Vice President Daggubati Purandeswari also criticised Congress leadership, alleging that the party had failed to take action against Akoijam despite the university's internal inquiry. Purandeswari said the university's Vice-Chancellor had constituted an internal committee after complaints emerged, and the committee found Akoijam guilty of molesting 11 female students. She also referred to an interview in which Akoijam had reportedly spoken about the number of complaints against him, saying she was surprised that he had spoken about the complaints in that manner. Purandeswari praised the students for coming forward with their complaints, saying it required courage to speak out against a professor while studying at the same institution. Questioning Congress leaders' public positions on women's rights, she said, On one hand we have Congress party leaders like Rahul Gandhi who says 'Smash the Patriarchy', and on the other hand we have Priyanka Gandhi ji who says 'Main ladki hoon, main lad sakti hoon' (I am a girl, I can fight). Today, we would like to question Priyanka Gandhi ji. She alleged that the Congress leadership's silence amounted to protecting Akoijam and called on the party to explain why it had not suspended or expelled him. Purandeswari also referred to allegations of misconduct against AAP MP Sanjay Singh during a recent protest involving BJP women workers, demanding an explanation from the opposition. A BJP women MPs' delegation, including Purandeswari, Swaraj and Chaudhary, met Speaker Birla and submitted a letter seeking action against Akoijam. The letter said the issue concerned respect for women, safety of girl students, moral accountability in public life and conduct of political parties. According to the letter, 11 female students had filed sexual harassment complaints against Akoijam, who was a professor at JNU before becoming a Congress MP from Manipur. The university's Internal Committee conducted an inquiry and found the allegations against him to be substantiated, following which the administration issued an order on October 9, 2026, dismissing him from service with immediate effect. The delegation also attached copies of the FIR and other documents. On Wednesday, Chaudhary said NCW chairperson Vijaya K Rahatkar assured the delegation she would look into the matter. We've been assured that she will definitely look into the matter given the situation, she said. Once the investigation found him guilty, he was fired, but under Congress's protection, Congress leaders haven't said a single word about him yet, she alleged. JNU dismissed Akoijam with immediate effect on October 9 after its Internal Committee recommended major punishment following an inquiry under the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act. Akoijam had earlier accused the administration of failing to provide him a copy of the inquiry report, needed to exercise his right to appeal, and alleged a violation of confidentiality under Section 16 of the POSH Act. Separately, Delhi Police registered an FIR on October 11 at Vasant Kunj North police station on a complaint by JNU's Chief Security Officer, under Sections 75, 75(1)(i), 75(1)(iv) and 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The matter is under investigation. Earlier, a delegation of BJP women leaders, including Lok Sabha MPs Kamaljeet Sehrawat, Bansuri Swaraj and Malvika Devi, Rajya Sabha MPs S. Phangnon Konyak and Geeta Shakya, and senior leader Rekha Sharma, met President Droupadi Murmu and submitted a memorandum seeking strict action. (ANI)

articles.title: Musk faces intense criticism after reports of Starlink restricted in Ukraine amid strikes from Russia
articles.summary: Billionaire tech mogul Elon Musk in facing intense scruitiny as his satellite communication network, SpaceX, finds itself at the center of an escalating international backlash, following reports of restrictions on satellite communications services in Ukraine amid continued Russian strikes, triggering criticism from US lawmakers and renewed questions over the power of private technology companies to influence the course of a war. As Ukraine grapples with the reported disruption of Starlink and Starshield connectivity, Musk has defended the distinction between the two systems, arguing that Starshield is controlled by the US government and that Starlink, a commercial service operated by SpaceX, cannot be used for offensive military action. The controversy has placed Musk at the centre of a politically sensitive debate over military communications, civilian safety and the extent to which a private company can determine access to critical technology during an armed conflict. The backlash intensified after the Democrats on the House Foreign Affairs Committee criticised the reported restrictions, linking them to Russian attacks and questioning the circumstances surrounding the disruption. Restricting Ukraine's Starlink and Starshield access while ballistic missiles and drones attack Ukraine is unconscionable. The admin also reportedly gave Kyiv no warning of the strikes. Trump's making a choice-and it directly aids Putin's slaughter of Ukrainian civilians, the Democrats House Foreign Affairs Committee said in a post on X. Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal also raised concerns about the reported disruption, warning that the episode could establish a dangerous precedent for the use of private technology in foreign conflicts. First, Trump said that Ukraine should get a new President. Then, Starlink, run by Elon Musk, was severely restricted in Ukraine -- meaning a majority of battlefield communications were totally stopped -- a move Ukraine is saying the US ordered. This sets a dangerous precedent of interference in foreign wars, and of the ability of a single corporation to shut off communications at will. We need answers, Jayapal said in a post on X. The criticism came as Ukrainian authorities sought to restore connectivity and assess the operational consequences of the reported restrictions. Mykhailo Fedorov, former Minister of Defence of Ukraine, said in a post on X that Starlink connectivity was being restored, while calling for the removal of restrictions affecting Starshield. Starlink connectivity at speeds of up to 160 km/h is being restored. Removing Starshield's speed limit entirely is now critical for Ukraine's defense. Thank you, Elon Musk. We hope for your continued support, Fedorov said. Musk responded by distinguishing between the two satellite systems and placing responsibility for Starshield restrictions on the US government. Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS. Starlink is a commercial service owned and controlled by SpaceX. Usage of Starlink is limited to civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company, he said. The explanation, however, has done little to quiet the debate over the reported disruption and the reliance of Ukrainian forces on satellite communications. According to Axios, Ukraine's military operations have been affected by restrictions on satellite communications services, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy raising concerns over disruptions to Starlink connectivity as Kyiv faces continued Russian strikes. Zelenskyy accused Musk of restricting Ukrainian access to Starlink during an interview with British broadcaster Piers Morgan on Piers Morgan Uncensored, alleging that the disruption had affected military operations and Ukraine's ability to defend against Russian strikes. I am sure they knew what they did, absolutely, Zelenskyy said, referring to the reported disruption. Because it was 1 am at night, (when) Starlink was blocked by SpaceX and the United States, he added Emphasising the system's role in protecting civilians, Zelenskyy said, It's not just about attack. It's also about defending life. He further said that the disruption had affected the ability to intercept incoming attacks. People were killed because, not enough destroying, not enough interceptors, including interceptors with Starlink, which didn't work. Of course, he added. Asked whether he was angry with Musk, Zelenskyy said, Yes, I think he is not right. It's a big mistake. I don't know him, or somebody pushed him to, I don't know really, he added. Warning of the possible consequences, Zelenskyy said, It's a big mistake.This decision will bring a lot of human losses. Of course, people will die. Of course, if attacks continue and if Starlink will not work, it's not helpful. According to CNN, Ukrainian authorities said they were caught off guard by restrictions affecting Starshield, the military-grade satellite communications system owned and controlled by the US government. CNN, citing two US officials, reported that the decision to limit Ukrainian access to Starshield was not a high-level US policy decision. Ukrainian forces rely on Starlink to operate reconnaissance and interceptor drones, gather intelligence and conduct other military operations. A Ukrainian military source with direct knowledge of the operational impact told CNN, The complications are substantial. We're investigating connection issues in detail. What will be affected is the front line and occupied territories, the source said, adding, We were getting ready for this. A Ukrainian defence ministry source also told CNN, This situation significantly complicates logistics, unmanned systems, forces operations, mid-range strikes, etc. The controversy has also brought renewed attention to India's cautious approach towards licensing Starlink, with security concerns at the centre of the regulatory debate. The Ministry of Communications had earlier rejected claims that India's licensing framework was discriminatory after Musk alleged that certain vested interests were blocking Starlink's plans in the country. The ministry's statement followed Musk's post on X claiming that Starlink's India plans were being blocked by certain oligarchs. In response, the Ministry of Communications stated that India had established a fair and non-discriminatory authorisation framework for telecommunications services, including satellite communications. It noted that telecom licences had been granted to three global mobile personal communication by satellite services using non-geosynchronous satellite orbit-based communications, while stressing that security compliance remained a prerequisite for moving forward. As criticism mounts over the reported restrictions in Ukraine, the episode has placed Musk in the middle of a debate that extends beyond his company's commercial ambitions
